index.badge: Smart Living · In-house Hardware · Integrated Solutions
index.hero_h1:
Let intelligence
blend naturally into every moment of life
index.hero_lead: Shanghai Ruowen Technology specializes in smart-living peripheral devices. With chip-level sensing, low-power connectivity and scenario-based algorithms, we turn complex technology into an experience you can use effortlessly every day.
index.core_title: We keep the complexity, you keep the simplicity
index.core_lead: From sensing and connectivity to scenario algorithms, our full in-house stack lets us tailor just the right intelligence to every way of living.
index.feat1_d: Self-developed low-power sensing and edge-computing modules make devices more aware of their environment — and more efficient.
index.feat2_d: A multi-protocol interoperability framework lets devices across brands and categories work together with one tap.
index.feat3_d: Algorithm models built on real-life rhythms anticipate needs proactively, rather than merely reacting.
index.feat4_d: End-to-end quality control and a 99.9% available platform make every connection reliable and stable.
index.prod_lead: Three core product lines cover intelligent sensing from spaces to bodies, all orchestrated by the Ruowen smart platform.
index.prod1_d: A local-first smart-home brain that unifies lighting, climate, security and media — stable even offline, protecting family privacy.
index.prod2_d: A 4-gram smart ring that monitors heart rate, sleep and activity around the clock, turning health data into actionable advice.
index.coop_title: Flexible smart solutions for every partner
index.coop1_d: From modules to finished products, we provide ODM / joint-development services to accelerate time-to-market.
index.coop2_d: Open device access and data capabilities let your existing products gain smart interoperability quickly.
index.coop3_d: Remote OTA, algorithm iteration and an operations dashboard accompany your product through its full lifecycle.
index.cta_title: Let's make life a little smarter, together
index.cta_p: Whether you seek hardware partnership, platform access, or want to learn about Ruowen's products, we look forward to talking with you.

about.hero_lead: Shanghai Ruowen Technology was founded in an era when smart hardware was spreading rapidly. We believe truly good intelligence should be imperceptible — it just makes life a little more effortless, again and again.
about.who_lead: From a low-power sensing module to a platform orchestrating an entire home, Ruowen's full in-house stack supports smart-living peripherals from concept to mass production.
about.mission1_d: With self-developed smart hardware, we lower the barrier to technology so every household can easily enjoy a more comfortable, reassuring daily life.
about.mission2_d: To become the most trusted R&D partner in smart-living peripherals, making “Ruowen” synonymous with quality and warmth.
about.mission3_d: User-centered design + chip-level R&D + scenario algorithms — a systematic approach that converges complexity into simplicity.
about.timeline_title: Every step brings us closer to the life we envision
about.tl1_d: The core team assembled in Shanghai, setting smart-living peripherals as the primary R&D direction.
about.tl2_t: First self-developed sensing module in mass production
about.tl2_d: Low-power environment sensing modules reached scale production, laying the foundation for full in-house capability.
about.tl3_d: A local-first smart-home hub delivered stable cross-category coordination with privacy protection.
about.tl4_d: The Ruowen Ring went on sale, extending health sensing to the body and completing the “home and people” experience.
about.tl5_d: Opened device access and data capabilities to industry partners, entering a platform- and ecosystem-driven phase.
about.val1_d: We start from real-life scenarios, not from tech for tech's sake.
about.val2_d: Core capabilities are built in-house, keeping our destiny in our own hands.
about.val3_d: We accompany products through their full lifecycle, iterating continuously.
about.val4_d: We build the ecosystem with partners, making the pie bigger for everyone.
about.cta_p: We are happy to share our R&D philosophy and product details, and welcome like-minded partners to talk.

products.hero_lead: Three core hardware lines + one smart platform, orchestrating sensing, connectivity and scenarios. From single products to an ecosystem, Ruowen delivers end-to-end R&D and go-to-market capability.
products.core_lead: Every product stems from a real-life scenario, emphasizing low power, long battery life and a seamless experience.
products.p1_d: A local-first smart-home brain that unifies lighting, climate, security and media — stable offline, privacy kept at home.
products.p2_d: A 4-gram smart ring that monitors heart rate, sleep and activity around the clock, turning health data into actionable advice.
products.p3_d: Integrated temperature, humidity, air-quality and presence sensing — low-power, long-lasting, letting spaces learn to “sense” their occupants.
products.p4_d: A customizable touch scene panel that switches home / sleep / away modes with one tap — easy for everyone, young or old.
products.p5_d: A lightweight combo of door sensors, cameras and presence detection with local encrypted storage and instant alerts to protect your home.
products.p6_d: Orchestrates all Ruowen devices with open APIs and a scenario engine, so devices truly “talk” to each other.
products.svc_title: Companion R&D from idea to mass production
products.svc_lead: Whether you are a brand, a channel or an innovation team, Ruowen can join your smart-product journey in a flexible model.
products.step1_d: In-depth scenario research to define the product and experience goals.
products.step2_d: Hardware design, algorithm tuning and rapid prototype validation.
products.step3_d: Supply-chain coordination and end-to-end quality control for stable delivery.
products.step4_d: OTA upgrades, algorithm iteration and an operations dashboard.
products.coop_title: Three ways to move forward with us
products.coop1_d: From modules to finished products, we provide joint R&D and manufacturing services to accelerate time-to-market.
products.coop2_d: Open device access and data capabilities let your existing products gain smart interoperability quickly.
products.coop3_d: Remote OTA, algorithm iteration and an operations dashboard accompany your product through its full lifecycle.
products.cta_title: Got a product idea? We'll help you build it
products.cta_p: Whether it's full-device customization or platform access, share your needs and the Ruowen team will plan it with you.
